authors: Laizhen Li, Xuan Wang, Peicheng Zhao

title: Ascent: An Agentic System over the Model Context Protocol for Real-World Clinical Data Analysis
description: Answering epidemiological questions from real-world clinical data requires medical coding, schema-aware SQL, and validation of implicit choices about populations, denominators, and time. We present Ascent, an agentic system that exposes medical coding, question answering, and cohort analysis through a shared Model Context Protocol tool surface for standardized and native schemas. authors: Angelo Ziletti, Leonardo D'Ambrosi, Melanie Tuchardt

title: MCPGen: Benchmarking LLMs on Executable MCPWorkflow Development
